{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mire nettle''' was a type of small, fungal weed that grew in the low-lying areas of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. It could be processed to make [[Nyriaan spice]], a type of powerful narcotic.
